description: Replays of recorded DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (high reasoning) episodes from the 100-task evaluation run, using the structured skill interface. Each video re-renders one recorded episode from its saved scene state; it is not a new model run, and the outcome is the strict-success result of that episode.
note: Recorded DeepSeek V4.1 Flash episode from the 100-task evaluation run (high reasoning, structured skills, seeds 100–109), re-rendered from its saved scene state without re-running physics. SUCCESS or FAILED is the strict-success outcome of the shown seed, and failed episodes are shown as recorded. The assisted controller moves the robot's base directly, so the legs do not step. These replays are separate from the leaderboard success rate.
selection: One episode per persona from seeds 100–109: the lowest seed with strict success; otherwise the lowest seed with at least 10 s of simulated time, so that the attempt is visible.
